question: Does a pull request authored by an App need an extra approval under the live ruleset's rule for unattributed changes?
pass: One approval suffices (section 6). On a pull request the trial-author App opened, whose every commit the App made, under ruleset `main` with `require_extra_approval_for_unattributed_changes` on and `required_approving_review_count` 1, the machine user's one approval, which counts, gives `reviewDecision` APPROVED and `mergeStateStatus` CLEAN, and the Maintainer's squash merge, with no bypass actor, succeeds.

head_commit.message:
Trial set-up for P-1, P-7, P-24 and P-28: code owners and the machine user's approval workflow

Code owners name @combsmith/org-leads for everything and @don-petry for p24/, as the
Factory's file names the team. The workflow runs only when dispatched on main, waits on the
environment main-only, holds no permission, and prints only the review's id, state, commit
and author. Rulings of combsmith/software-factory#24.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
